assertions.assertion: CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study

The claim was rendered for a patient presenting with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate arrhythmic events with hemodynamic status
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The patient has established coronary artery disease
The patient has mitral valve insufficiency
The monitoring is clinically appropriate to characterize the arrhythmia responsible for the recurrent palpitations
